dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Good afternoon. How can I help you?
dialogue.reading: ˈɡʊd ˌæftərˈnuːn. ˈhaʊ kən aɪ ˈhɛlp juː?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: This is Sophie. She's a tourist from Australia, and she had her wallet stolen at the market.
dialogue.reading: ˈðɪs ɪz ˈsoʊfi. ʃiːz ə ˈtʊrɪst frəm ɔːˈstreɪliə, ənd ʃiː ˈhæd hɜːr ˈwɑːlɪt ˈstoʊlən ət ðə ˈmɑːrkɪt.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: I'm sorry. Was it a pickpocket?
dialogue.reading: aɪm ˈsɑːri. wʌz ɪt ə ˈpɪkpɑːkɪt?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Yes, I think so. The market was very crowded, and I didn't feel anything.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, aɪ ˈθɪŋk ˈsoʊ. ðə ˈmɑːrkɪt wʌz ˈvɛri ˈkraʊdɪd, ənd aɪ ˈdɪdənt ˈfiːl ˈɛniθɪŋ.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Many tourists are victims of pickpockets there. What was in the wallet?
dialogue.reading: ˈmɛni ˈtʊrɪsts ər ˈvɪktɪmz əv ˈpɪkpɑːkɪts ˈðɛr. ˈwʌt wʌz ɪn ðə ˈwɑːlɪt?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: My cash, my bank cards and my ID card.
dialogue.reading: maɪ ˈkæʃ, maɪ ˈbæŋk ˈkɑːrdz ənd maɪ ˌaɪˈdiː ˌkɑːrd.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Then you need a police report. Please fill out this form.
dialogue.reading: ˈðɛn juː ˈniːd ə pəˈliːs rɪˌpɔːrt. ˈpliːz ˈfɪl ˈaʊt ˈðɪs ˈfɔːrm.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Officer, could the thief use her cards to steal her identity?
dialogue.reading: ˈɔːfɪsər, kʊd ðə ˈθiːf ˈjuːz hɜːr ˈkɑːrdz tə ˈstiːl hɜːr aɪˈdɛntəti?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: It's possible. Criminals often use stolen cards. She should call her bank today.
dialogue.reading: ɪts ˈpɑːsəbəl. ˈkrɪmɪnəlz ˈɔːfən ˈjuːz ˈstoʊlən ˈkɑːrdz. ʃiː ʃʊd ˈkɔːl hɜːr ˈbæŋk təˈdeɪ.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Last year, I had my email hacked. It was a nightmare!
dialogue.reading: ˈlæst ˈjɪr, aɪ ˈhæd maɪ ˈiːmeɪl ˈhækt. ɪt wʌz ə ˈnaɪtmɛr!

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Then please change your passwords, too.
dialogue.reading: ˈðɛn ˈpliːz ˈtʃeɪndʒ jʊr ˈpæswɜːrdz, ˈtuː.
